_source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Alchemical_Hydra and /Strategies (phases, vents, specials, max hits, damage); the cache for every id; rsprox captures 1000143, 1000471, 1000473, 1000480 and 1000497 (rev 227, 150+ kills) for the timings, cadences, geometry, sounds and messages the Wiki leaves out (docs/alchemical-hydra.md). Where a recording differs from a value the Wiki states, the Wiki's value is used and the recorded one is noted beside it (_recorded).

names._npcs: The gameval numbers don't follow the phase order: by the Wiki's infobox, hydraboss_4 (8619) is the electric phase and hydraboss_2 (8621) the enraged one, as monsters-complete's 4-tick, 55-max stats for 8621 agree.
names._special: The enraged form has no special sequence: its poison is thrown with hydra_stage_4_attack_ranged (rsprox: 96 of 96 enraged poison throws).

sounds._source: rsprox captures 1000471/1000480: sound_area ids, delays and ranges per event

room._lightningCentre: rsprox: every lightning caster lands on (1367, 10267), 152 of 152
room._currentQuadrants: rsprox: each of the four currents starts on a random tile of its own 3x3 block, one block a quadrant, in a random order (x 1360-1362 / 1371-1373, y 10261-10263 / 10272-10274)

vents._timing: rsprox: the three geysers erupt together every 8 ticks (3,856 of 3,863 gaps) on the world's clock while a player is in the chamber, go off 5 ticks later, and 2 ticks after the eruption a vent tile under the Hydra's 6x6 footprint weakens or empowers it (934 of 934 messages)

_transitionTicks: rsprox: ticks from a phase's death sequence to the next form's spawn sequence, 157 changes each: 2 (142) or 3 out of serpentine, 1 (134) or 2 out of electric, 2 (86) or 3 (71) out of flame

combat._styles: Max hits are the Wiki infobox's (serpentine 17x2 / 26x2 empowered, electric 35 and 26x2 empowered, flame 35 / 52 empowered, extinguished 55); which style throws how many comes from rsprox: serpentine fires two projectiles a style, electric two magic and one ranged, flame and enraged one (5,671 attacks). The electric 17x2 is its magic: 114 recorded electric magic hits never pass 17 while its ranged hits reach 31 (45 empowered), so the infobox's 35 is the electric ranged and 26x2 its empowered magic.
combat._attackDistance: rsprox: it attacks from up to 9 tiles of its footprint (from the door, 8 off, on the tick the player comes in) while it walks in, and it walks while the player is 5 or more tiles from its footprint, stopping at 4 (stays on 13,643 of 13,773 ticks at 4, walks on 1,654 of 2,078 at 5; the rest are its phase changes and flame special). Issue 6284.
combat._switch: rsprox: three basic attacks a style, the count carried across phases ("RwMMS"); the switch sequence plays 3 ticks after the third, also before a special
combat._special: rsprox: a phase's fourth attack is its special, then every tenth (nine basic attacks between, 30 recorded runs past the second special); the Wiki: 'after the first three auto-attacks, then after every nine subsequent auto-attacks'

projectiles._flight: rsprox: every magic and ranged flight starts at cycle 30 and ends at 40 + 5 a tile from the Hydra's south-west tile to the target (2,786 flights, none off), the second head's at height 35
projectiles._heads: rsprox: the launch tile, from the Hydra's south-west tile, by the way it faces the target; a second head launches from the same tile pulled one tile inside the footprint's inner 4x4

poison._source: The Wiki: a 3x3 splash up to 7, pools up to 12 a tick, poison 6 for the targeted blob and 4 otherwise, one enraged blob while the flame phase's fires remain. rsprox: five blobs, the first on the player's tile and the rest on others within a few tiles; flights 30 to 60 + 10 a tile; they land 3 ticks on, the pool 1 tick later, and pools hurt for 13 ticks (on 1-13 of 13 ticks stood in, none from 14). Enraged: one blob while the fires' blockers stand (94 of 98), five once they are gone (53 of 55).
poison._recorded: Recorded pool ticks hit 2-7; the Wiki's maximum of 12 is used.

lightning._source: The Wiki: four currents close in on the player and bind them for up to 22, dissipating on a phase change. rsprox: the caster flies 30 to 40 + 5 a tile onto the room's centre; 3 ticks later the currents leave it, one a tick (flights 15+30n to 30+30n), each showing on its tile and stepping a tile toward the player every tick for 12 ticks; a player paralysed by one first moves 3 ticks after it (24 of 24 clicks on the hit tick).
lightning._recorded: Recorded current hits are 8-17; the Wiki's 22 is used.

fire._source: The Wiki: it walks to the centre, stuns the player, breathes fire to the player's sides, then a tracking fire hitting up to 25 and burning 5 five times; solid while the fires last. rsprox: the walk ends on its spawn tile, blockers cover it that tick and the stun follows a tick later (104 of 104); the three breaths come 3, 6 and 9 ticks after the blockers, each turned 45 degrees from the player's diagonal (clockwise first, then counter-clockwise, then the diagonal itself, 83 of 83 runs from the north-west and north-east); each wall is 4 wide and 8 long, 45 + 5 cycles a tile; the tracking fire follows for up to 11 ticks; the next attack comes 12 ticks after the third breath; the fires' blockers stand for 56 ticks (30 of 70 runs, the rest cut short); a burn ticks every 5 ticks and clears 25 after the last scorch; a stunned player first moves 7 ticks later.
fire._recorded: Recorded tracking-fire hits are 9-17; the Wiki's 25 is used.

kill._respawn: the Wiki infobox's 43 ticks. Recorded difference: rsprox shows the next Hydra 12 ticks after the dead one is removed (22 after its death sequence starts), in 150 of 155 kills.
kill._death: rsprox: the enraged form plays hydra_stage_4_death, 3 ticks later becomes the dead form playing hydra_death, and is removed 7 ticks after that, with the fight duration and kill count (152 kills)
